description: This Java source file contains integration tests for loan repayment schedules in the Apache Fineract project. It specifically tests scenarios involving charges after maturity, schedule rescheduling, and advanced payment strategies, focusing on how charges and schedule adjustments affect the repayment plan.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleForChargesAfterMaturityTest
classes.description: JUnit integration test class for verifying loan repayment schedule adjustments after charges are added or rescheduling occurs, particularly focusing on post-maturity charges, schedule changes, and advanced payment strategies.

methods.name: loanNPlusOneInstallmentIsRetainedAfterLoanRescheduleTest
methods.description: Tests that the N+1 installment is retained after rescheduling a loan installment when charges are added after the original schedule.

methods.name: loanNPlusOneInstallmentIsAdjustedAfterRescheduleIfDateFallBeforeMaturityDateTest
methods.description: Verifies that the schedule adjusts correctly when rescheduling occurs before the charge due date, which is after the original schedule but before the new schedule's due date.

methods.name: loanNPlusOneInstallmentIsRetainedAfterLoanRescheduleForAdvancedPaymentAllocationTest
methods.description: Checks that the schedule remains consistent when using advanced payment allocation strategies after rescheduling with charges added post-maturity.

methods.name: loanNPlusOneInstallmentIsAdjustedAfterRescheduleIfDateFallBeforeMaturityDateForAdvancedPaymentAllocationTest
methods.description: Ensures schedule correctness when rescheduling occurs before maturity for loans utilizing advanced payment strategies.

methods.name: incorrectValueAfterCharge
methods.description: Validates handling of large charge amounts and correct installment calculations post-charge addition.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithMultiDisbursalAndRepayments
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with multiple disbursals and repayments for testing.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithMultiDisbursalAndRepaymentsWithAdvancedPaymentAllocationStrategy
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with advanced payment allocation strategy, multiple disbursals, and repayments.
